title: Topics of conversation other than padel

copy.heading: Topics of conversation other than padel

blocks.text: Your stakeholders have prepared a list of safe topics. Each one has been tested on real people who do not play padel, and none of them leads back to padel unless you make it.

text: • The children. Specifically what they did today, not what sport they might be good at.
• Lauren's work. She has a job. It has people in it. Some of them are ridiculous.
• Your own work, minus any padel stat.
• Something on the telly, other than sport.
• The weather, as weather, and not as padel weather.
• The news. Any part of it that isn't about a new club opening.
• A book, a film or a podcast that is not about padel, or about "mindset".
• Where to go for tea on Friday.
• Whether it's the green bin or the black bin this week. It's the green bin.
